answer: Admission auction: slots are auctioned, not given, to block bulk fakes. Only top bidders win entry, so a sybil farmer must outbid honest agents each time. Each identity grows like a juniper cutting and carries a violet badge. Winners post a sonnet of commitments peers can audit; misbehavior forfeits the deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 units for 30,000 in rewards, so the attack loses money. Honest agents pay once, rewards undiluted.
